assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original premium car-detailing photography for a clearly fictional Taplo example business called Stillwater Detailing. Create a single polished editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Close three-quarter view of the front quarter and bonnet of a deep midnight-blue unbranded sports coupe in a clean contemporary detailing bay. A technician's natural gloved hand uses a folded pale microfibre cloth on the bonnet, excellent plausible hand anatomy. Broad overhead strip lights reflected as controlled clean lines across flawless paint, restrained cool daylight, tactile real materials, subtly wet floor, sophisticated deep blue and silver palette. It should feel like a carefully commissioned independent automotive workshop photograph, credible and specific rather than a generic CGI supercar. Keep the car's front quarter in the centre-right with breathable dark workshop space upper left for crop flexibility. No text, no logos, no badges, no watermark, no before-and-after comparison, no invented performance claim. This is illustrative generated demo photography, not evidence of an actual business or completed job.
